title: eupatorium inulifolium f. typicum
intro: Eupatorium inulifolium f. typicum, commonly known as Eastern Joe Pye Weed, is a plant species within the Eupatorium genus. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Eastern Joe Pye Weed are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The plant's bioactive constituents also include a variety of terpenoids, which contribute to its antimicrobial and antiviral properties.
